# M18-S7 REDTEAM #194: eject keeps a region program's output.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^7 42 6$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=

logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ../..
cd m2
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
logos run .
stdout '^5200 18 55$'
cp stdout $WORK/native2-stdout.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native2-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ../..
cd m3
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
logos eject -o out
grep '_ = grouped' out/main.go
grep '_ = ifRegion' out/main.go
grep '_ = forRegion' out/main.go
grep '_ = switchRegion' out/main.go
env GOEXPERIMENT=
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ../..
cd m4
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
logos run .
stdout '^7 11$'
cp stdout $WORK/native4-stdout.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native4-stdout.txt
# REDTEAM #194: type-switch shadowing preserves native/eject parity.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionparity

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

type node struct {
	v int
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[node](r)
	p.v = 7
	s := arena.Make[int](r, 3)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = i * i
	}
	t := arena.Append[int](r, nil, 1, 2, 3)
	sum := 0
	for _, v := range t {
		sum += v
	}
	fmt.Println(p.v, p.v*6, sum)
}
-- m2/go.mod --
module example.com/regionparity2

go 1.27

-- m2/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func fibR(r arena.Region, n int) int {
	t := arena.New[int](r)
	*t = n
	if n < 2 {
		return *t
	}
	a := fibR(r, n - 1)
	b := fibR(r, n - 2)
	*t = a + b
	return *t
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	total := 0
	for i := range 50 {
		s := arena.Make[int](r, 4)
		for j := range s {
			s[j] = i + j
		}
		for _, v := range s {
			total += v
		}
	}
	inner := 0
	{
		rIn := arena.Open()
		t := arena.Append[int](rIn, nil, 5, 6, 7)
		for _, v := range t {
			inner += v
		}
	}
	fmt.Println(total, inner, fibR(r, 10))
}
-- m3/go.mod --
module example.com/regionunused

go 1.27

-- m3/main.lgo --
package main

import "logos/arena"

func main() {
	var (
		grouped = arena.Open()
	)
	_ = arena.New[int](grouped)
	if ifRegion := arena.Open(); true {
		_ = arena.New[int](ifRegion)
	}
	for forRegion := arena.Open(); false; {
		_ = arena.New[int](forRegion)
	}
	switch switchRegion := arena.Open(); {
	default:
		_ = arena.New[int](switchRegion)
	}
}

-- m4/go.mod --
module example.com/regionparity3

go 1.27

-- m4/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func run() error {
	shadow := 0
	switch r := arena.Open(); r := any(arena.New[int](r)).(type) {
	case *int:
		shadow = *r + 7
		go group (context.Background(), limit = 2) {}
		go group (context.Background(), limit = 2) { shadow += *r }
	}
	distinct := 0
	switch r := arena.Open(); q := any(arena.New[int](r)).(type) {
	case *int:
		distinct = *q + 11
	}
	fmt.Println(shadow, distinct)
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
